questions.prompt: In the procrastination model, what does expectancy mean?

options.text: How strongly you believe you can complete the task.

questions.explanation: Feeling capable can increase motivation; a task that seems impossible can invite delay.

questions.prompt: Why can a distant reward make starting harder?

options.text: Immediate rewards tend to feel more compelling.

questions.explanation: The model highlights our preference for rewards available sooner.

questions.prompt: How does the episode suggest using the equation?

options.text: As a precise law for every person.
As proof that procrastination is permanent.
As a way to identify what is making a task hard to start.

questions.explanation: It is presented as a practical mental model, rather than a complete account of behavior.
